title: LanLeg v1 — one observed channel between two real nodes (node_a opened it, node_b accepted it): the network path it crossed (lan, tailnet, or loopback), the unaided discovery road that brought the nodes together (seed or mdns; none is a record a judge refuses), the TLS version and cipher the handshake itself reported, the Y-011 key fingerprint each side read out of the other's handshake certificate, whether both nodes' Y-052 announcements were exchanged and admitted, how many Y-050 fabric messages crossed in each direction, and simulated — true when the carriage was a stand-in (a socketpair or loopback in a test), false only when real network separated the nodes (Y-062)
